title: Robotic Origami Challenge
about: Teleoperated bimanual robot with two Sharpa Wave hands folding a 6-fold paper airplane; five camera-based fingertip tactile sensors per hand. The official release lists 1,991 episodes in 143 seasons (2026-05-14 to 2026-07-18), 1,845 of them with data files.

hardware.d: 5 fingertip tactile sensors per hand · raw image, deformation map, 6-axis signal · 30 Hz
2 × 7 arm joints, 7 torso/motor joints; 65-D state and action
One task in every episode; teleoperation device not stated

notes: Data © Sharpa, released under CC BY 4.0 for the Robotic Origami Challenge (https://robotic-origami-challenge.github.io/). The Hugging Face repository is gated: log in and agree to share your username and email with the authors (automatic approval). Each sample is a 45 s window of one episode, cut from the release's per-episode files and re-encoded for this page. All three tactile streams are shown: the fingertip deformation map pooled to 8 × 8 cells, the 6-axis fingertip signal (arrow, ring and plots), and both tactile videos as mosaics.
